## Testing

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`

## Checklist

- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` for a release-worthy change.
- [ ] Updated source JSON under `packs/_source` and rebuilt packs when needed.
- [ ] Tested the affected behavior in Foundry.
- [ ] Added or updated tests for the change.
